PROCEEDINGS OF THE CITY COUNCIL 
CITY OF LONG BEACH 
MEETING OF AUGUST 20, 2024 
 
Present: Council President Finn and Council Members Bendo, Fiumara, Lester, and Reinhart.   
 
1. 
Local Law Correcting Local Law V/24: Amending the Charter of the City of Long Beach Re: City 
Officers; Their General Powers and Duties 
 
Summary:  This ordinance will correct an error in L.L. V/24.  Section g mas mislabeled as section e. 
 
Full text of this ordinance is available from the Office of the City Clerk, or online at 
http://www.longbeachny.gov/councilmeetings. 
Adopted Unanimously 
 
2. 
Amendatory Bond Ordinance of the City of Long Beach, New York, Amending and Restating Bond 
Ordinance Adopted April 4, 2023 
 
Summary:  This ordinance will amend the Bond Ordinance from April 4, 2023 (used for Long Beach Water 
Pollution Control Plant and the South Shore Water Reclamation Facility) to pay for a portion of the costs of the 
Project, in the amount of $5,000,000 that will not be paid by FEMA or GOSR and, as a result, the City will 
need to finance such portion of the costs of the Project through the issuance of bonds or bond anticipation notes 
which will not be subject to reimbursement by FEMA or GOSR. 
 
Full text of this ordinance is available from the Office of the City Clerk, or online at 
http://www.longbeachny.gov/councilmeetings 
Adopted Unanimously 
 
3. 
An “Ordinance to Amend the Code of Ordinances of the City of Long Beach Re: Building Code and 
Appendix A Zoning” was tabled unanimously. 
 
Summary:  This ordinance will codify the ban on short-term rentals in the City of Long Beach 
 
Full text of this ordinance is available from the Office of the City Clerk, or online at 
http://www.longbeachny.gov/councilmeetings. 
 
4.
